messages:
incident-bot: P1 page | inference-api-west1 — error-rate spike (5xx) across host pool. PagerDuty alert: PD-4821. Affected customers: a few high-throughput embeddings jobs. Escalation timer 15m.
Aisha Khan: I'm taking primary for the remainder of this shift — picking up pager.
Tom Reynolds: I'm secondary. I'll own comms unless Elena takes it.
Priya Patel: Handoff update before I sign off in ~20m: error started ~09:42 UTC, correlated with a kernel update on the dedicated pool. We rolled a 10% canary to avoid churn; errors persisted. Current mitigation: increased pool size + routed low-priority batch traffic to fallback cluster.
Tom Reynolds: Copy. Do we have a quick customer-impact statement?
Priya Patel: Impact: embeddings requests for customers X/Y/Z are failing with 502 or timing out >5s. No evidence of data corruption. Estimated % of traffic impacted ~8-12%.
Elena Gomez: I can handle external comms. I'll draft a status blurb for customers and the dashboard.
Aisha Khan: Action plan: (1) I'll drive the immediate mitigation — restart problematic node instances sequentially (to not cause global drop), (2) Tom will do comms with Elena, (3) Priya will handover telemetry pointers and the kernel rollback steps if needed.
Priya Patel: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx-spike — checkout the "kernel-update fallback" section. Quick commands:
```
# check pod health and recent restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference-runtime -o wide
kubectl describe pod <pod-name>
# curl a health endpoint against one of the hosts
curl -v http://10.11.12.13:8080/healthz
```
Aisha Khan: I'm going to restart node inference-worker-3 first (graceful drain -> restart). Will watch KV cache miss rates and latency during drain.
Tom Reynolds: If restart doesn't reduce 5xx within 10m, prepare for canary rollback to model-quantized-1 (lower perf but stable). Priya, can you provide the exact rollback command?
Priya Patel: Yes — the rollback is in the runbook, but quick flag: `redwoodctl rollout set inference-api --model model-quantized-1 --canary 20` then monitor `redwoodctl rollout status`.
incident-bot: Escalation timer set (15m) — auto-escalate to eng-sre if no mitigation noted.
Elena Gomez: Drafted customer blurb (short): "We're investigating higher error rates for embeddings in west1 affecting a subset of jobs. Engineers are actively mitigating; no data loss expected. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes." Agree?
Tom Reynolds: LGTM. I'll post to #customers-status and ping account reps for X/Y.
Aisha Khan: Handoff checklist for incoming driver (me):
- Primary: Aisha Khan (driving)
- Secondary: Tom Reynolds (escalation & comms)
- Comms owner: Elena Gomez
- Runbook: inference-5xx-spike (link above)
- Pager: active on PD-4821
- Open items: node restart in progress, monitor latency & 5xx, prepare rollback if no improvement in 10m
Priya Patel: All set from my side. I'll be reachable for 10 more minutes then off shift — handing over logs and Grafana dashboards to Aisha.
Aisha Khan: Thanks Priya — noted. I'll mark this as "handoff accepted" and continue the mitigation.
Tom Reynolds: I'll coordinate posting status updates and escalate to SRE if incident-bot timer fires.
Elena Gomez: I'll post initial customer note in 5 mins and update with timeline.
Aisha Khan: Starting restart on inference-worker-3 now. Will report back.
incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty ack by Aisha Khan recorded.
Aisha Khan: Restart completed on worker-3, services came back, observing 5xx rate dropping from ~11% -> ~3% over the last 4m. Continuing to monitor for 15m.
Tom Reynolds: Nice. Elena — hold the update until we confirm steady state for 10m?
Elena Gomez: Yep, will wait.
Priya Patel: Logging handover: stack traces + kernel package diff uploaded to the incident channel artifacts.
Aisha Khan: Taking full ownership for the incident now. Priya — thanks for the handoff. Priya signing off.
Priya Patel: Good luck team — off. :wave:
Aisha Khan: Confirming drive & comms owners: I'm driving, Elena doing public comms, Tom is escalation backup. All set.
Tom Reynolds: 👍
Elena Gomez: 👍
incident-bot: Incident thread note closed for handoff. (incident remains active).
